what_this_is: Trial name to ClinicalTrials.gov identifier for issue two, so study_design.py can check the page's design characterisations against the registry instead of against a model's guess.
how_these_were_established: Each NCT was confirmed by reading the registry's own title on 2026-08-31, not by recall and not by taking the first search hit. Searching 'MONARCH 2' by title returns NCT02747004 and NCT02102490 first, and neither is MONARCH 2; the right record is NCT02107703, whose official title begins 'MONARCH 2: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 3 Study'. A trial map assembled from search results without that check would have quietly pointed three claims at the wrong studies.
note_on_PALOMA-1: NCT00721461 is recorded here because the page names PALOMA-1, but that identifier does NOT resolve to PALOMA-1 -- it is a tolerability study of an electroporation device. It is the wrong id, carried over from sources.json, and is flagged in the source audit of 2026-08-31. Left in place deliberately so the checker reports it rather than silently skipping the trial.
